caseAssociations.behavior: Genuine approved implementing lifecycle with ignored, untracked, HEAD-absent private State; actual configure route and fresh installed hook permit ordinary paired configuration commit without changing State.
Unchanged predecessor hook refuses the same actual private-State paired configuration commit; HEAD and State remain unchanged.
Forged or missing retained approval proof refuses preparation without altering State or twins.
Supported configured chat approval remains eligible and commits through the ordinary fresh hook without a new signature requirement.
Opaque-handle provenance, real prepare/write/complete lifecycle, exact index inspection and consumed-handle refusal.
Actual HEAD drift invalidates the sealed transition.
Private State raw-byte or continuity-revision drift invalidates the transition.
Actual public approval trust-policy drift invalidates approval and transition.
One-twin staging and extra real staged paths refuse even when caller presents the expected twin list.
Changed command, extra configuration key or divergent twins refuse the exact transition.
Independent protected gate modifications refuse inspection and actual ordinary commit.
Actual twin hardlink or symlink, executable index mode and unsafe ready-record mode refuse.
Missing, partial, noncanonical or extra-key ready records cannot grant commit authority.
Partial twin publication retains the genuine held preparation and refuses completion or implicit reclaim.
Post-commit identical configuration replay performs no writes; a changed command cannot reuse the old seal.
Genuinely produced approved implementing State tracked in HEAD remains accepted by the separate legacy route.
